summary: Frontend testing of 3 high-priority bugs in NovaClinicsPro. All 3 bugs verified as FIXED after Expo restart.

issues: Session persistence issue on URL navigation - ProtectedRoute check runs before auth bootstrap completes after page reload. This is a known Expo Router web limitation.

bug_1_login_network_error.details: Login with valid credentials (hareshlekkala@gmail.com) successfully redirects to Super Admin dashboard. Login with invalid credentials shows user-friendly 'Invalid login credentials' error instead of generic network error.

bug_2_casesheets_prescriptions_404.details: Routes were fixed in source code but stale bundle was being served. After Expo restart, navigation to casesheets/new and prescriptions/new works correctly. URL format: /clinic-admin/clients/[clientId]/casesheets/new
bug_2_casesheets_prescriptions_404.note: Old route in bundle was /clinic-admin/case-sheets/create, new correct route is /clinic-admin/clients/[clientId]/casesheets/new

bug_3_quick_action_buttons_missing.details: Quick action buttons (Reschedule, No-Show, Cancel) are visible on appointment cards for scheduled/confirmed appointments. showActions=true is being passed correctly to AppointmentListItem component.

critical_code_review_comments: All 3 bugs have been correctly fixed in source code
The Expo bundler was caching an old version of the code - this is why Bug 2 appeared unfixed initially
After restarting Expo, the new bundle was generated with correct routes
Require cycles in casesheets and prescriptions modules should be refactored to avoid potential initialization issues

success_rate.backend: N/A - External Koyeb backend, not tested

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 high-priority bugs (Login Network Error, Casesheets/Prescriptions 404, Quick Actions missing) have been verified as FIXED. The user hareshlekkala@gmail.com is a Super Admin (isOrgAdmin=true) and gets redirected to /super-admin dashboard. To test clinic admin features, click 'Clinic Admin' button from the super admin dashboard. Quick actions appear on appointments with status 'scheduled' or 'confirmed'. The Expo Router web session persistence issue still exists (auth tokens lost on URL navigation/page reload).

rca_of_the_issue.bug_1_root_cause: useAuth.ts was not providing user-friendly error messages. Fixed by mapping Supabase error codes to friendly messages.
rca_of_the_issue.bug_2_root_cause: The VisitHistoryCard component had incorrect route paths (/clinic-admin/case-sheets/create). Fixed by correcting to /clinic-admin/clients/[clientId]/casesheets/new. Bundle was stale until Expo restart.
rca_of_the_issue.bug_3_root_cause: Code analysis shows quick actions were correctly implemented but conditional on (canReschedule || canMarkNoShow || canCancelAppt || canComplete). These conditions check user role and appointment status - verified working for clinic_admin role with scheduled appointments.
